title: A person's profile
summary: Shows another person: photo, name, @, trust marks and bio, with what the user can do (message, add to a group, block, report). From a DM it is also the DM's info screen (ADR 0141).

url.description: socialUrl(platform, handle), built on the device.

kind.description: verifiedName: bipe_badge_verified_name_via with the scheme name and the badge name, from the strongest proof, only when the badge name differs from the display name (see notes). company: bipe_badge_company, opens company-seal. companyRevoked: bipe_badge_company_revoked. companySuspended: bipe_badge_company_suspended. confirmedInPerson: bipe_badge_verified_contact. nameSuspended: bipe_badge_suspended with bipe_badge_suspended_body.

scheme.description: A registries/schemes.json id. A badge with no person scheme gives no proof (fail closed).

mark.description: bank: sealCheck regular. state: sealCheck fill.

line.description: bipe_badge_verified_via with the scheme name of the locale.

identity.description: Identity proof. verified: the company mark or the verifiedName mark, with bipe_trust_identity_body under it. suspended: companySuspended or nameSuspended. unverified: no mark.

contact.description: Personal confirmation. confirmed: confirmedInPerson with bipe_trust_contact_body. unconfirmed with a known lifecycle: a neutral line bipe_trust_contact_unconfirmed.

change.description: identity, device or deviceAndIdentity: an amber card with bipe_banner_security_change and bipe_trust_change_confirm_action. unknown after the read ran: bipe_trust_lifecycle_unknown with bipe_trust_lifecycle_retry_action.

isOfficial.description: userId is exactly a user ID in registries/official-accounts.json: the Bipe badge after the name (bipe_badge_official, label bipe_badge_official_a11y), as in chat-list.

isCompany.description: GET /v1/accounts/{userId}/type is company: the avatar is a rounded square, else a circle (ADR 0132).

marks.description: Only marks that verify on this device (see notes). Empty for most people today.

proofs.description: personProofs (test-vectors/person-proofs.json) over the badges of GET /v1/badges/{userId}/proofs that verify on this device, strongest first. Empty for a company, for a suspended badge and when no badge verifies.

facts.description: The separate trust facts of the person (ADR 0074, docs/trust-facts.md), from BipeTrustSources: identity, contact and change, each shown apart (see notes).

reservedNameWarning.description: The name is a reserved name (normalize, registries/reserved-names.json), the person is not an official account (isOfficial) and no company mark verifies it: bipe_warning_reserved_name under the name.

bio.description: PublicProfile.bio when the person has a public profile on, with bipe_public_profile_not_verified under it.

of.description: One network: its registry name, the handle and the link from socialUrl.

socials.description: PublicProfile.socials when the person has a public profile on, in registries/profiles.json socials order, unknown ids skipped (ADR 0228). Empty: no section.

dmRoomId.description: Client.getDmRoom: the newest DM with the person, when one exists.

isBlocked.description: The user id is in Client.ignoredUsers: bipe_app_person_blocked, and block turns into unblock.

fromDm.description: Opened from a DM header: the title is bipe_dm_details_title and the DM rows show (notifications). No delete row: a DM is archived from the chat-timeline chat menu, never deleted here (mz, 2 November 2026).

of.description: One number, formatted with displayPhone when it normalises (registries/phone-numbers.json), else as saved.

savedNumbers.description: ADR 0191, bipe-chat/bipe#788: the numbers of the viewer's own address-book entry that POST /v1/contacts/lookup matched to userId. Empty without contacts permission or without a match: no row.

profileFacts.description: ADR 0049 facts of the person, in order (account age, photo, name), from POST /v1/profile-facts when the screen appears, with the account age at any age (ADR 0275 point 13). Empty when the call fails.

appear.effect: Client.getProfile for name and photo; POST /v1/handles/resolve for the @; GET /v1/accounts/{userId}/type; GET /v1/badges/{userId}, verified on the device, for the compact seal; GET /v1/badges/{userId}/proofs, each badge verified on the device, for proofs; GET /v1/profiles/{handle} for the bio; Client.getDmRoom; Client.ignoredUsers. The screen shows what it has and fills in the rest. With contacts permission: savedNumbers (see notes).

message.effect: Opens the DM in chat-timeline. Without one: Client.createRoom with isDirect true, isEncrypted true, preset trustedPrivateChat and the person invited, with the DM power levels of ADR 0141, then opens it.

share.effect: Only when the person has an @: the system share sheet with the profile link (BipeProfileLink, https://bipe.chat/@<handle>).

openSocial.effect: Opens socialUrl(platform, handle) in the system browser, which hands off to the network's app when it is installed. Never an in-app web view, never a link preview.

addToGroup.effect: Lists the user's groups where RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserInvite, and invites the person to the chosen one (bipe_dm_invite_to_group, bipe_dm_invite_to_group_empty).

newGroup.effect: Opens group-create with this person picked.

notifications.effect: fromDm only: opens chat-notifications for the DM.

block.effect: Opens block-person to block or unblock.

report.effect: With a DM: opens report-chat for it. Without one there is nothing to report: the row is hidden.

retryFacts.effect: Reads the person's identity again (Encryption.userIdentity with fallbackToServer true) and evaluates the facts.

openSeal.effect: isCompany with a company mark: opens company-seal. A person seal or a proof line: opens person-seal, for the strongest proof from the seal, for that proof from a line. An amber seal opens nothing.

notes: One DM test (ADR 0141): the DM is Client.getDmRoom for this person, the newest room. The DM shows the person's name and photo, never m.room.name or m.room.avatar.

Avatar: when Client.getProfile gives no photo (the server hides the profile of a person with no shared room), the avatar shows photo_url of GET /v1/profiles/{handle}. With the public profile off it stays the initial.

A new DM (ADR 0141, bipe-chat/bipe#532): power levels that let neither person invite or change room settings, from registries/dm-power-levels.json (BipeDmPowerLevels). Client.createRoom gets a PowerLevels override with an empty users map: rooms are room version 12, where the server refuses a creator in that map with a 400, and a creator needs no level to write the first state and the invite. Right after, Room.sendStateEventRaw writes the m.room.power_levels content of BipeDmPowerLevels.content with an empty users map: users default 0, invite, kick, ban, redact of other people's events and room settings at 100, messages, reactions, redactions of own events and call membership at 0. If that write fails, the DM stays usable. A creator keeps unlimited power in room version 12 whatever these levels say. Old DMs keep their power levels. The other person's invite can be refused by their who-can-message setting (ADR 0038): show bipe_app_group_invite_refused with the name, and create nothing.

Reach budget (security.md rule 11, bipe-chat/bipe#846): when a new DM or an add to a group fails with M_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, the app reads GET /v1/me/reach. When used >= budget, the notice is bipe_reach_limit_body with resets_at as a local date and time (bipe_reach_limit_body_none when resets_at is null), followed by bipe_account_status_raise_verify or bipe_account_status_raise_wait for raise_by. Else, and when the read fails, bipe_error_generic. Nothing is created. Spec account-status shows the budget.

Trust marks come from the badge envelope only (ADR 0041, security rule 2), verified on the device against the keys of registries/badge-keys.json, the sender and the account's cross-signing master key. The user cannot write a mark. Company marks come from a cnpj badge (ADR 0042, ADR 0123). verifiedName and nameSuspended come from a pix or govbr badge (ADR 0239, bipe-chat/bipe#596). No issuer signs those two levels in production yet (bipe-chat/bipe#17, bipe-chat/bipe#543), so verifiedName stays empty until one does. Bipe logic: BadgeVerifier, BipeCompanySeals, BipeCompanySealState and BipePersonSealState (BipeKit); BadgeVerifier, BipeCompanySeals.kt (libraries/bipe company).

Master key: the apps read UserIdentity.masterKey() from matrix-sdk-ffi (encryption().userIdentity, fallbackToServer true). Every badge binds to it (ADR 0239), so a badge shows on any device of the account. No master key: no seal (fail closed).

Separate trust facts (ADR 0074, bipe-chat/bipe#227, #229): the screen evaluates BipeTrustFacts (registries/trust-facts.json, test-vectors/trust-facts.json) through the profile adapter BipeTrustSources (BipeKit, libraries/bipe). Its inputs are only authenticated sources: UserIdentity.masterKey (the key every fact binds to), UserIdentity.isVerified (confirmation in person), UserIdentity.hasVerificationViolation (the identity changed after the confirmation) and the verified company or person seal. The SDK gives states, not times, so the adapter writes the order it reports: a change at 1, a current proof at 2. No identity or no master key: lifecycle unknown, nothing verified. A seal never confirms the person; a confirmation never verifies a name. An identity change drops the confirmation and shows the amber card. bipe_trust_warning_absence_body shows under the facts whenever a positive fact shows: no warning is no safety assertion. The company mark, the verifiedName mark and the seal next to the name follow facts.identity, so they fail closed with the facts.

Integration gaps (state them, never fake them): no issuer signs name badges in production yet (bipe-chat/bipe#17, bipe-chat/bipe#543), so verifiedName stays empty; the SDK has no complete device history, so change device is not reported (bipe-chat/bipe#33); there is no flow to confirm another person in person yet, so bipe_trust_contact_confirm_action is not shown.

confirmedInPerson: the person's identity is verified by the user (UserIdentity.isVerified, after an in-person QR or emoji check). It is a different fact from a verified name (linguagem.md: confirmar, not verificar).

Official accounts (ADR 0117, bipe-chat/bipe#384): isOfficial is an exact match of the full user ID with registries/official-accounts.json, never the name or the @ (a test account named Novidades do Bipe gets no badge and keeps reservedNameWarning). The official accounts own their reserved names, so they never get reservedNameWarning. Bipe logic: BipeOfficialAccounts.isOfficial (BipeKit, libraries/bipe).

Reserved names (parity reserved-names): reservedNameWarning uses the same normalize() and registry as profile-edit. A company whose verified seal names it does not get the warning. Bipe logic: NameNormalizer.reservedCategory (BipeKit), NameNormalizer.kt (libraries/bipe).

The @ comes from POST /v1/handles/resolve and is cached per user ID. Bipe logic: BipeHandleResolver (BipeKit, libraries/bipe). The public profile bio comes from GET /v1/profiles/{handle}; a 404 means no bio.

A person's number shows only from the viewer's own address book (ADR 0191, bipe-chat/bipe#788). The server never sends another person's number. With contacts permission, the app takes the address-book entry that POST /v1/contacts/lookup matched to userId (the match from the contacts screen or group-invite-members in this session; without one, one lookup of the address book per session, as contacts check) and reads that entry again to get its numbers. A row bipe_person_number lists savedNumbers, with bipe_person_number_footer. The app keeps the match in memory as user ID to address-book entry ID, never the numbers, and drops it when the permission goes. No permission or no match: no row. The number is for discovery only, never identity or sign-in (ADR 0015).
Calls are out of scope for this issue (client-rewrite-plan.md section 4, phase 3).

Brand marks (ADR 0162, spec brand-mark): a reseller's verified marks show as one line under the name (first mark, then bipe_brand_mark_more); a tap opens the brand-mark sheet. bipe_brand_mark_ended shows once there after a mark the phone saw is gone.

Profile change facts (ADR 0049, bipe-chat/bipe#598): below the header, apart from the trust facts; appear reads POST /v1/profile-facts for the person. Each line of profileFactLines (registries/profile-facts.json, test-vectors/profile-facts.json) on POST /v1/profile-facts: created is bipe_profile_fact_created (%1$s the age since at, formatted by the system: "3 dias"); photo and name with count 1 are bipe_profile_fact_photo_once and bipe_profile_fact_name_once (%1$s the age since at), with a count of 2 or more bipe_profile_fact_photo_times and bipe_profile_fact_name_times (%1$s the count, %2$s windowDays). No lines: nothing shows, no empty row.
Media and files (bipe-chat/bipe#672): a DM opened from its chat has a row bipe_gallery_title that opens chat-media-gallery for the DM.

Social accounts (ADR 0228): under the bio, a section titled bipe_public_profile_socials with one row per entry of socials: the network name and @handle, with an outbound link mark. Under the rows, bipe_public_profile_socials_not_verified in secondary ink. A tap runs openSocial. The app builds the link from the registry template and never shows a URL from the server. Bipe logic: BipeSocialHandles (BipeKit, libraries/bipe).

Person seal (bipe-chat/bipe#596, ADR 0239): a pix or govbr badge that BadgeVerifier accepts and that gives facts.identity verified. BipeCompanySeals holds it per account with the company seal, from the same GET /v1/badges/{userId} call and cache: 10 minutes, 2 minutes after an error, never past exp. A failed fetch drops the seal (fail closed) and keeps a suspended state. verified: the seal next to the name, label bipe_badge_verified_via. A tap opens person-seal (ADR 0275). Suspended: only when this phone saw the seal before and the badge no longer verifies (master_key_mismatch after an identity reset): the outline sealWarning icon in amber replaces the seal, with bipe_badge_suspended and bipe_badge_suspended_body. A new cross-signed device does not suspend (security rule 4). A 404 or 410 shows no seal and no notice and forgets the seal that this phone saw.

List of facts (ADR 0275 points 12 to 16): below the header, one list with no bar and no score. Lines, in order: one line per entry of proofs; with no proof and no company mark, bipe_banner_unverified_title; a verified company, bipe_badge_company; a suspended badge, bipe_badge_suspended with its amber seal in place of the proof lines; then profileFacts (the account age always, then the ADR 0049 lines); then bipe_badge_verified_contact, only for the viewer who confirmed. Each proof line starts with its mark. Steps 1 to 3 of the ladder, the CPF, the bank, a percentage and missing steps never show (ADR 0275 points 5, 6 and 8). Warnings stay above the list.

Verified name line: bipe_badge_verified_name_via shows under the name only when normalize(badge name) differs from normalize(display name). When they match, the header already shows the verified name, and the list says how it was checked. The sheet always shows the verified name.

Fail closed (ADR 0275 point 2): the level comes only from a badge that verifies on this device. A badge that fails, an unknown scheme or a failed proofs call adds no line. When the proofs call fails and the compact seal verified, the list shows the proof of the compact seal. No profile field and no other server field can set a level.

Seal mark, the same in every place (trust-ui.md): the compact mark next to a name, in person-profile, the chat-timeline header of a DM, a DM row of chat-list and the sender line of a group row (timeline-rows). personBank (assurance bank, Pix): sealCheck regular in verified ink. personState (assurance state, gov.br): sealCheck fill in verified ink. Both have the label bipe_badge_verified_via with the scheme name, and show the strongest proof only (ADR 0275 points 3 and 15). The two icons carry the difference, never colour. company: sealCheck in verified ink, label bipe_badge_company. personSuspended: sealWarning in caution ink, label bipe_badge_suspended. companySuspended: sealWarning in caution ink, label bipe_badge_company_suspended. none: nothing. A revoked company seal shows no compact mark. Colour never carries the state alone: the icon and the label do. Bipe logic: BipeCompanySeals.mark (BipeKit, libraries/bipe company); SealMark in each app.

Official avatar (ADR 0117): every avatar of a user ID in registries/official-accounts.json, and of the news room, is the Bipe mark in ink.onAccent on accent.fill, in a rounded square with a corner of 25% of the side (a circle inside a group's member cluster). The app draws it on every screen. It reads no profile photo, so a failed image load or a changed photo cannot replace it. The mark follows the app's colour palette, as the app icon does.
The groups account (official-accounts.json role groups) shows bipe_groups_service_about under the @.

Official badge (ADR 0117): the Bipe badge shows after the name of an official account wherever that name shows as a person or a chat: chat-list rows and favourites, the mural, chat-search chat results, the chat-timeline header, the sender line of a group message, mention suggestions, chat requests (a DM request), contacts and the people pickers that can list the account, the blocked list, group-members and person-profile. The news room counts as official in chat lists, its header and its info. A name in running text, such as a state line, shows no badge.
